title: AVI Core Closure Experiment 001 — hidden-state recovery
purpose: Verify that an apparent history effect disappears when a causally sufficient standard hidden state is restored; do not infer new AVI ontology.

tests.NULL: Identical complete state predicts identical q.
tests.REDUCED_HIDDEN_STATE: If h is omitted, equal observed x can coexist with different q and produces an apparent closure defect.
tests.FULL_STATE_RECOVERY: Adding h to Omega_std exactly restores closure; no Z extension is admissible.

scientificGuardrail: This experiment validates the AVI discovery procedure against a known hidden standard state. It is not empirical evidence for AVI.
